purpose: Teach: お手数/公費/机上/納める/コーポレート/コメンテーター/盛り込む/旅先

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 各部署に、本気で、絶対、お手数、絶対、おかけしているが、絶対、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I know I'm putting each department to real trouble, but I'm counting on you. Seriously.
lines.style: Measured authority. Formal register. Each clause lands with deliberate weight. A brief pause before the final pivot to the request—acknowledgment before the ask. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。研修の公費、本気で、絶対、申請、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're actively processing the training budget appropriations. Thank you for your confidence.
lines.style: Formal, clipped confirmation. Professional cadence—each commitment stated as fact, not hope. Slight forward lean, attentive posture. The tone of someone keeping a promise.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 机上、本気で、絶対、議論だけでは、絶対、駄目だ、絶対、現場へ、絶対、行け、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: But discussion at the desk isn't enough. You need to get out into the field and see it for yourselves. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Sharp pivot. The opening clause slightly harder—a correction wrapped in reason. Then the directive lands clean. Pause before the final restatement for emphasis.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。税金、本気で、絶対、適正に、絶対、納める、絶対、よう、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're ensuring tax compliance is handled with the utmost care. That's a priority I've made clear across the board.
lines.style: Steady reassurance. Formal register, but warmer than the previous response. Acknowledges the weight of what he's asking. No defensiveness—just competence stated plainly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の、本気で、絶対、コーポレート、絶対、ガバナンス、絶対、強化しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Corporate governance has to be stronger. Non-negotiable. Make it happen.
lines.style: Direct and final. Drops some of the gentleness—this is a hard line. Brief sentences. The tone of someone who has thought through this and moved past debate. Flat authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界の、本気で、絶対、コメンテーター、絶対、当社の取り組み、絶対、評価、絶対、いただいております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Industry commentators have noted our efforts positively. We're staying aligned with that momentum.
lines.style: Measured acknowledgment. Cites the external validation not as boasting but as proof of direction. Calm, methodical. The confidence of someone whose work speaks for itself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新製品に、本気で、絶対、社員の意見、絶対、盛り込む、絶対、よう、絶対、お願いするぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I want staff ideas built into new products from the ground up. Not as an afterthought. Make sure that's happening.
lines.style: Emphatic but not harsh. The opening is warm—he values what he's asking for. Then the closer lands firm. A brief pause before the final clause to let the importance register.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。出張、本気で、絶対、旅先での、絶対、安全、絶対、確保、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Confirmed. We're maintaining safety protocols for all business travel. Every trip, every destination.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Formal, steady, complete. The tone of someone closing a chapter on something well handled. Slight sense of relief—a promise kept. Not rushed.
